    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: none "No return value; the method initializes instance state."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the incoming current_temperature value to the instance attribute self.current_temperature. RESULT self.current_temperature]
            [COMMAND Assign the incoming target_temperature value to the instance attribute self.target_temperature. RESULT self.target_temperature]
            [COMMAND Assign the incoming mode value to the instance attribute self.mode. RESULT self.mode]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]

Thermostat.set_mode:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "This method updates the device mode only when the input is either 'heat' or 'cool', and returns False otherwise." set_mode]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> mode </REF>: string "Requested mode value to validate and assign."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "Returns False when the mode is invalid; otherwise no explicit value is returned."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether the input mode is exactly one of the allowed values 'heat' or 'cool'. RESULT mode_is_valid]
            [COMMAND If the mode is valid, assign the input mode to self.mode. RESULT self.mode]
            [COMMAND If the mode is invalid, exit early by returning False. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The input mode is not 'heat' or 'cool'.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Do not modify self.mode. RESULT self.mode_unchanged]
            [COMMAND Return False immediately to signal rejection of the input. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Thermostat.auto_set_mode:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Sets the mode to heat when the current temperature is below the target temperature, otherwise sets it to cool." auto_set_mode]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compare self.current_temperature with self.target_temperature using a strict less-than check. RESULT temperature_comparison]
            [COMMAND If self.current_temperature is less than self.target_temperature, assign self.mode to 'heat'. RESULT self.mode]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, assign self.mode to 'cool'. RESULT self.mode]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Thermostat.auto_check_conflict:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Checks whether the thermostat mode matches the temperature relation to the target, returning True when it does and otherwise auto-adjusting the mode before returning False." auto_check_conflict]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Thermostat instance providing current_temperature, target_temperature, mode, and auto_set_mode()."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True if the current mode matches the temperature condition; otherwise False after triggering an automatic mode adjustment."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compare self.current_temperature with self.target_temperature using a strict greater-than check. RESULT temperature_above_target]
            [COMMAND If self.current_temperature is greater than self.target_temperature, check whether self.mode equals 'cool'. RESULT cooling_side_mode_match]
            [COMMAND Within the branch where self.current_temperature is greater than self.target_temperature, return True when self.mode is 'cool'. RESULT True]
            [COMMAND Within the branch where self.current_temperature is greater than self.target_temperature, otherwise call self.auto_set_mode() and return False. RESULT False]
            [COMMAND If self.current_temperature is not greater than self.target_temperature, check whether self.mode equals 'heat'. RESULT heating_side_mode_match]
            [COMMAND Within the branch where self.current_temperature is not greater than self.target_temperature, return True when self.mode is 'heat'. RESULT True]
            [COMMAND Within the branch where self.current_temperature is not greater than self.target_temperature, otherwise call self.auto_set_mode() and return False. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Thermostat.simulate_operation:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Auto-select the operating mode, then increment or decrement the current temperature one unit at a time until it reaches the target temperature while counting the total time steps." simulate_operation]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance holding mode, current temperature, target temperature, and auto mode selection behavior."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: integer "The number of one-unit temperature adjustment steps performed."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.auto_set_mode() to determine or refresh the operating mode before any temperature adjustment. RESULT mode]
            [COMMAND Initialize use_time to 0 as the step counter. RESULT use_time]
            [COMMAND If self.mode equals 'heat', repeatedly increase self.current_temperature by 1 while it is strictly less than self.target_temperature, and increase use_time by 1 on each iteration. RESULT heat_adjustment_loop]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, repeatedly decrease self.current_temperature by 1 while it is strictly greater than self.target_temperature, and increase use_time by 1 on each iteration. RESULT cool_adjustment_loop]
            [COMMAND Return use_time after the current temperature reaches the target temperature. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
